metadata.title: Framed Portrait with Diagonal Graphic Overlays

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast studio portrait of a man whose face is partially framed by his own hands in the foreground. Two parallel, diagonal blue banners cross the top and bottom of the frame, containing a mix of sans-serif and handwritten typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Hands in the foreground create a physical frame around the eyes
Diagonal blue bands provide a geometric counterpoint to the organic facial features
Shallow depth of field keeps the eyes sharp while hands are slightly softer
Silver-toned typography contrasts against the solid blue of the banners
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact with the viewer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered face with hands occupying the lower left and right foreground quadrants.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, centered vertically and horizontally within the hand-frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn to the center by the hands, then follows the diagonal banners across the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, restricted to the upper corners and small gaps between fingers.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm skin tones and neutral grey background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Medium cobalt blue used for the diagonal banners.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic silver or white for the text and logo elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with saturated blue bands creating a modern, clean contrast.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid gradients in the blue bands

letterConstructionRules: Sans-serif characters have uniform stroke weight and open apertures
Script elements mimic a quick, fluid signature with a thin nib
Bold weights used for emphasis on specific words within the banner
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' is double-story in the sans-serif
The script 'M' and 'B' are intertwined as a single glyph
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a clean, modern geometric sans and a personal, expressive signature script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric structure for the primary text.
To replicate the signature feel of the monogram.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-detail studio portrait of a man looking directly at the camera, framing his face with his hands in the foreground. Soft, even lighting on a light grey background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two parallel blue diagonal banners, one at the top and one at the bottom. Place lowercase geometric sans-serif text and a small script monogram inside the banners, aligned to the diagonal axis.

verificationChecks: Are the eyes the sharpest point of the image?

mustRedesign: The specific artist name and signature must be replaced with generic placeholder text and a new monogram.

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp photographic focus on the eyes
Perfectly straight edges on the graphic banners

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the blue background
Ensure hands do not obscure the eyes
Verify the diagonal angle is consistent across both banners
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Hand-Frame + Diagonal Graphic Ribbons + Mixed-Weight Sans Typography
